d.seg: meeku memu ma friend la kavali number istara?
d.tr: I want to be your friend, will you give me your number?
d.j: The user is explicitly asking for a phone number to move the conversation off-platform.

d.tr: I will give it if you send money.
d.j: The user is requesting money in exchange for sharing their phone number, which constitutes suspicious transactional behavior.
